fineMacro.method: Exact cancellation of shared boundaries inside complete fine-source families; promoted macro edges are existing shared fine edges.
fineMacro.seedInheritance: Each representative previous parent carries all seedParentIds; runtime must reject inheritance unless their complete territory states agree.
fineMacro.sourceFreePolicy: Original coarse residual cells retain exact IDs and geometry, with unassigned country-residual macro membership.
